text:
acme_sre: Hey team, following up — customer is seeing repeated 403s from /v1/erase for tenant acme-123 after a config change. They also reported a short latency spike (~3x) right before errors. Need urgent help, legal asking for evidence of deletion attempts.

sam_support: Sorry about that. I reproduced a 403 when I tried a purge for acme-123. Error: "KMS auth failed: unauthorized (wrapped-key verification)". No obvious rate limit. Logged request id: req-0a1b2c.

jamie_oncall: Looping SRE. I see a latency bump around 2025-11-02T09:12Z in our ingest metrics for the dedicated pool serving acme-123, concurrent with several HSM handshake retries.

alex_infra: Quick summary from infra: acme-123 uses a customer-managed CMK which is proxied to HSM cluster in eu-west. We pushed a KMS agent update yesterday that changed TLS renegotiation behavior. Could be related.

acme_sre: Customer confirms they rotated keys yesterday but rotation was handled by their KMS vendor. They didn't change our CMK ARN. They shared an example curl that fails:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/erase -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -d '{"tenant":"acme-123","subject_id":"u-987"}'
# response: {"error":"KMS auth failed","code":403}
```

sam_support: Can we get the exact HSM response from our logs? I need the error chain for legal to show attempted deletion.

jamie_oncall: Pulling logs now. Raw snippet from proxy logs: "HSM_RESP: 0x23 (UNAUTHORIZED_KEY_WRAPPER) at handshake step 3; retry=2". Also saw several 504s from the agent-to-hsm RPC during the spike.

alex_infra: Repro steps I'm running: 1) replicate acme-123 config in staging; 2) run targeted erase; 3) capture agent and hsm proxy traces. If we hit 403, I'll capture agent debug (ENABLE_HSM_DEBUG=1) and post.

acme_sre: Customer also flagged a billing anomaly — they were charged for tokens on the erase API call attempts even though the operation failed. They want credits for the failed requests.

sam_support: Noted. I'll open an internal billing ticket and pause automated billing for those request ids (req-0a1b2c, req-0a1b2d). Do we have logs to show whether tokens were consumed before error?

alex_infra: Usually token accounting happens upstream of KMS wrap; however, for erase we attempt metadata + KMS unwrap before final accounting. I need to check sequence in the trace. If the KMS call fails early, tokens should not have been billed, but we'll confirm.

elena_privacy: From privacy/legal side: customer requires proof that deletion was attempted and whether any residual copies remained. Please include audit log export (immutable) and KMS audit events. The DPA requires a timeline and outcome within 72h.

jamie_oncall: I exported the per-tenant audit stream for acme-123 (range 2025-11-02T08:50 to 2025-11-02T09:30). Attaching link: https://internal-logs/redwood/audit/acme-123/20251102.gz (internal). Key events: erase request received -> kms-wrap -> kms returned unauthorized -> erase aborted.

sam_support: Sharing that with customer now and offering credits pending root cause. Also asking them for KMS vendor logs around rotation window (they volunteered).

acme_sre: Sending our KMS vendor trace now, they show an asymmetric wrap error immediately after rotation window, but claim our agent kept old key-id in cache for ~20s. Could be a race.

alex_infra: That aligns with our proxy logs where we see an old key-id lookup returning 404 and then an unauthorized on the follow-up wrap. Mitigation: I'll push a small change to invalidate local key-id cache sooner and add an extra retry path for wrap-unavailable -> re-fetch-key. I'll coordinate a short deploy to staging and receptor the handshake latency.

jamie_oncall: Short-term mitigation: add a fallback to our erase flow to try a secondary model that uses server-managed key (non-CMK) for ephemeral operations when CMK fails — but only for non-PII-sensitive ops and with customer opt-in. For this customer's DPA delete request we must stick to CMK unless they allow alternate flow.

elena_privacy: Customer will not opt-in. So we need to show attempted deletion and re-run the erase once keys are consistent. Also include preserved audit log and HSM events as evidence.

sam_support: Action items: 1) alex: deploy cache invalidation + re-fetch retry to staging and try repro (ETA 2h). 2) jamie: verify billing accounting for failed erase reqs and file for credit if billed (ETA 4h). 3) alex/jamie: produce HSM + audit export and timestamped timeline (ETA 6h). 4) sam: send interim status to customer and legal.

alex_infra: Started a canary branch, test run in progress. Patch includes: 
```
- drop_key_cache_on_wrap_error=true
- max_wrap_retries=3
- ENABLE_HSM_DEBUG=1
```
I'm seeing a successful wrap in staging after forcing a rotation. Posting full trace when done.

acme_sre: Thanks. Customer wants to confirm erase completes after we fix this and wants a one-time credit for the failed attempts.

sam_support: Will scope credit after billing confirms. For now, customer update sent: "we've identified an upstream key-rotation race; engineering is patching cache behavior and will re-run your erase. We'll provide audit artifacts and billing credits as appropriate." :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy started: infra/cache-patch -> staging (sha: abcdef123)

jamie_oncall: Logging this as an incident for postmortem if patch doesn't fully address headroom. Ticket INC-2025-712 created.

acme_sre: Appreciated. Please keep me in loop, will escalate to their security/compliance team if timelines slip.

sam_support: Will update in this thread every time we have artifacts to attach.

alex_infra: Patch verified in staging, performed erase replay against staging tenant, got no 403s, HSM handshake stable. Preparing audited export now.

jamie_oncall: Billing confirms the failed real-tenant requests were not charged; credits not required. I'll confirm in writing.

elena_privacy: Once you have the export, format it as: (1) audit log bundle (gz), (2) HSM event dump (signed), (3) timeline.txt. Send via our secure transfer to customer and copy legal.

sam_support: Got the bundle. Uploading to secure link and sharing with acme. Closing interim loop.

acme_sre: Received artifacts and confirmed erase retried and completed after fix. Thanks all.

sam_support: Closing thread — will keep INC-2025-712 open for any follow-ups on production rollout of cache invalidation. :white_check_mark:
